messages:
anya: quick sync — compact action stack for model table rows. trying to reduce vertical noise in compact mode but running into focus clipping and icon alignment. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi101/compact-rows

mike: share screenshot? :eyes:

anya: https://imgur.com/compact-row-snap. current css prototype:
```css
.row-action { padding: 4px 8px; height: 28px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; }
.row-action svg { transform: translateY(-1px); }
```

sam: visual looks tighter but 28px breaks touch target. prefer keeping visual at 28px but add invisible hit padding (44px total). wrapper technique works well.

nina: focus ring clip is from .row-card { overflow:hidden } to preserve card shadow. options: move actions into overflow-visible slot or use outline-offset token. moving slot is more robust.

mike: avoid translateY on svg. set explicit svg w/h + flex centering. eg: .row-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px } .row-action svg { width:16px; height:16px }

anya: copy nit: change button "Deploy" -> "Start deployment" in compact view for clarity. anyone object? remember i18n.

sam: good change. also suggest creating tokens: focus.outlineOffset=4px and touch.hitPadding=8px so implementation consistent.

design-bot: created tokens: spacing.compact=6px, touch.hitPadding=8px, focus.outlineOffset=4px, toast.duration.short=1200ms, toast.duration.medium=2200ms. PR: #523. :robot_face:

mike: QA reminders: add visual-regression snapshots for compact row default/long-label/icon-only and test RTL. add unit that asserts effective bounding box >=44px.

nina: i'll draft a11y test cases (keyboard nav, hit-target verification, SR labels for icon-only).

anya: plan: update figma, remove svg hacks, add hit-wrapper, move actions to overflow-visible slot, update copy/i18n, and open a small PR. aiming for this week. ping me if you want to pair on the PR.

sam: :thumbsup:
